items.title: Firefly Aerospace (FLY) Is Up 16.2% After Record Q2 Sales And New Lockheed Launch Deal - Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, Firefly Aerospace reported record sales of US$117.68 million but widened its net loss to US$92.32 million, alongside a two-year extension of its multi-launch agreement with Lockheed Martin for up to 25 Alpha Block II rocket missions through 2031 and a US$93.7 million U.S. Space Force radar contract.
